retrievalProfile.description: A tight, extreme close-up portrait featuring a vertical sidebar and layered, overlapping serif typography across the subject's forehead.
triggerTerms: extreme close-up portrait with overlapping text
vertical blue sidebar with white serif text
excludeWhen: minimalist modern sans-serif layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up of a male face, cropped from forehead to chin, characterized by warm, saturated skin tones and a direct gaze. The composition is framed by a solid blue vertical bar on the left containing rotated text, while the top of the image features multiple layers of serif typography in varying colors that overlap the subject's skin.
coreVisualRelationships: Tight facial cropping creates intimacy and intensity
Overlapping text on the forehead integrates typography with the subject
The vertical blue sidebar provides a structural anchor against the organic facial forms
Warm orange-brown skin tones contrast with the cool blue sidebar
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up cropping focusing on eyes, nose, and mouth
Overlapping serif typography across the upper third of the frame
A distinct vertical color-blocked sidebar on the left edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered horizontally, filling 85% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned in the upper third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves up to the overlapping text, then down the vertical sidebar to the mouth.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the face fills the majority of the frame, with the sidebar acting as the only significant non-subject area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm brown and amber skin tones
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and muted red for typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in skin tones with deep shadows; high contrast between white text and dark backgrounds.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single serif family used in different colors and orientations.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic high-contrast serif look of the 90s.
Provides the necessary stroke contrast and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up portrait of a man with warm skin tones, focusing on the eyes and nose, with a solid navy blue vertical bar on the left 15% of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add high-contrast serif text in white and muted red, overlapping the forehead area in multiple layers, and add vertical white serif text inside the blue sidebar.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait an extreme close-up?
Does the text overlap the subject's forehead?
Is there a vertical blue sidebar on the left?
Is the font a high-contrast serif?

mustAchieve: Balanced color contrast between blue and orange

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite overlapping
Verify the vertical sidebar is perfectly straight
Check that the skin texture looks natural and warm
Confirm the eyes are the primary focal point
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme close-up portrait + vertical sidebar + overlapping serif display type.
